correctness.rationale: The bracket is a nondegenerate anisotropic norm form; all bracket-preserving automorphisms reduce to affine semilinear maps. Explicit conjugation gives seven disjoint types: scalar/Frobenius paired slopes and semilinear norm/trace strata; their class sizes sum to 2q²(q²−1). Class number, commuting formula and involution orders follow. A standalone checker independently reconstructs similitudes and enumerates all conjugacy classes, sizes, involutions for q=3,5,7,9; all checks pass. Field characteristic, quantifiers and q=9 extension are addressed; finite tests do not prove the general result.

originality.rationale: The novelty assessed is not the known abstract or matrix form of the automorphism group, nor q=3 as an isolated finite group: it is the exact seven-stratum conjugacy-class SIZE distribution, the norm-one trace bifurcation, involution-orbit sizes, and all-field polynomial for an infinite family. The 2023/2024 primary classification and the 2026 full compilation describe the groups but do not give the conjugacy-size table. The full-text affine-class-counting paper gives a general orbit tool for AGL/AGU/ASp/AO, not the affine two-dimensional similitude group in this theorem. value.rationale: Complete conjugacy class-size distribution, norm/trace orbit structure and involution classification are natural invariants of the full symmetry group of a standard nilpotent Leibniz family. The result is uniform across infinitely many odd finite fields, extends the known group-identification theorems quantitatively, and provides class number and commuting probability as useful structural consequences rather than a cosmetic reparametrization. Residual external priority risk is explicitly acknowledged.
